sources.observation: Public profile search snapshot identifies Simon Willison and lists Datasette, sqlite-utils, LLM, shot-scraper, files-to-prompt and other repositories under the account.
Datasette is an open-source multi-tool for exploring and publishing data, with interactive website/API, plugins, publishing workflows and a long-lived documented product surface.

LLM is a CLI and Python library for interacting with many model providers; it includes logging, embeddings, schemas, tools, attachments, plugins and an explicit release/news history from 2023 through 2026.
sqlite-utils is a Python CLI/library for manipulating SQLite, including import/query, FTS, transforms, migrations and plugins.
Recent August 2026 history includes release 4.2/4.2.1 and maintainer commits for smoke tests, transforms, constraints, AUTOINCREMENT, strict tables, indexes and introspection.
Repository is owned by simonw and has thousands of commits and an active public release/issue ecosystem.
Repository is owned by simonw and exposes a broad plugin-oriented LLM CLI/library surface.
Repository is owned by simonw and remains actively maintained in August 2026.

scope_boundaries: Repository ownership plus sustained maintainer history supports strong independent-project authorship at project level, but not sole authorship of every line or merged contribution.
README feature breadth supports product/tool design exposure, not mastery of every dependency/provider/backend.
Do not infer AI-generated implementation merely because the LLM project concerns AI.
Do not infer database-engine internals mastery from SQLite tooling alone.
